class.name: flux_tools/Image
class.description: Shows a sensor_msgs/Image published over a flux channel, read from shared memory inside rviz2 without going through DDS.

class.name: flux_tools/PointCloud2
class.description: Shows a sensor_msgs/PointCloud2 published over a flux channel, read from shared memory inside rviz2 without going through DDS. Rendering is the stock point cloud renderer.
